value.rationale: As the monomial degree increases, rank alone leaves the size and location of the singular mass undetermined. The exact phase boundary p=2/(1-alpha), beta-integral bulk coefficient, critical harmonic residue, and paired edge zeta/series coefficient quantify a natural high-frequency effect across a continuous family of Hilbert spaces. The exponent characterizes growing-degree mass, not trivial membership of a fixed finite-rank operator.
